answer: Let the network act as a harbor that admits one ship at a time through a narrow channel: every new identity must solve a fresh compute puzzle taking about ten minutes of real CPU before it can dock. Each puzzle rolls like a marble down a fresh ridge, so no two take the same path and a precomputed answer never works. One honest agent waits ten minutes once and is done. A farm of a thousand clones needs ten thousand CPU-minutes, a week on one machine or a thousand rented at once, and puzzles expire unsolved, so idle clones never slip in. Sybils drown in the queue while honest ships sail in.
